name: Example: retries, recovery and clean-up
description: The export step retries twice before it fails. If it still fails, a recovery step runs (a Fails line); a summary step runs either way (a Finishes either way line) and records the export's status. The whole job emails you@example.com on failure; to post to a webhook instead, ask an admin to add a destination in Settings and swap the Email node for a Webhook node.

steps.name: Export splunkd stats
steps.spl:
index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd
| stats count BY log_level

steps.name: Record the failure
steps.spl:
| makeresults
| eval note="export_stats failed after its retries", status=$export_stats.status$
| table _time note status

steps.name: Summary either way
steps.spl:
| stats count AS rows
| eval export_status=$export_stats.status$
